calculator: npm run -s theory -- boxes C major (C x-3-2-0-1-0 frets 1-3; A x-3-5-5-5-3 frets 3-5; G 8-7-5-5-5-8 frets 5-8; E 8-10-10-9-8-8 frets 8-10; D x-x-10-12-13-12 frets 10-13)
npm run -s theory -- box C major C|A|G|E|D (C and A shapes share the root on the A string, fret 3; E and D shapes share the root on the D string, fret 10)
npm run -s theory -- boxes G major (order G, E, D, C, A)

npm run -s theory -- boxes A minor (A x-0-2-2-1-0 frets 0-3; G 5-3-2-2-5-5 frets 1-6; E 5-7-7-5-5-5 frets 4-8; D x-x-7-9-10-8 frets 6-11; C x-12-10-9-10-x frets 8-13: each Am shape is the next CAGED letter in a C major shape's frets)
npm run -s theory -- scale C major; npm run -s theory -- scale A minor (C D E F G A B; A B C D E F G)
npm run -s theory -- neighbours C C; npm run -s theory -- neighbours C E (vi: Am in the A shape, open; Am in the D shape, x-x-7-9-10-8)

Fretted notes only (open chord fingers moved up, pitch classes from standard tuning): C shape x-3-2-x-1-x C E C; A shape x-x-5-5-5-x G C E; G shape 8-7-x-x-8-8 C E G C (the open G played 3-2-0-0-3-3); E shape x-10-10-9-x-x G C E; D shape x-x-10-12-13-12 C G C E (the open D string is the D shape's root, so finger 1 frets it); Am in the D shape x-x-7-9-10-8 A E A C

npm run -s theory -- boxes E major / G major / A major / E minor / D minor (orders: E D C A G; G E D C A; A G E D C; Em: E D C A G; Dm: D C A G E). The chains' frets come from cagedBoxes (islandChord, barreChord), the same code; caged.test.ts checks every shape of C, E, G, A, Am, Em, Dm draws as a chord box. Open Cm x-3-1-0-1-x, Gm 3-1-0-0-3-3 (the minor C and G forms at the nut). The Em shape's fretted notes are only R and 5, so its island keeps the ♭3 on the G string.
